newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac not to intervene before first round - sources.
newsitem.headline: Chirac not to intervene before first round - sources.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac does not plan to make a formal appeal to voters before Sunday's first round of a snap parliamentary election, sources close to him said on Tuesday.
However the conservative head of state may use his regular scheduled events to comment on the campaign for the May 25-June 1 election, they said.

Chirac is due to hold talks on European Union integration and NATO enlargement with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl on Tuesday night, chair a regular cabinet meeting on Wednesday and attend an informal EU summit in Noordwijk, the Netherlands, on Friday.

Opinion polls published before a legal blackout imposed last Saturday at midnight showed Chirac's centre-right coalition and the combined left virtualy level in voting intentions, but projected the coalition would win a comfortable majority of National Assembly seats due to the two-round voting system in single-member constituencies.
